description.zh: 从光速不变出发：光钟的时间膨胀、时空图与洛伦兹变换、同时性的相对性、缪子寿命的实证、相对论速度合成，以及动能发散说明有质量的粒子到不了光速。惯性观察者、一维、c = 1 的模型。
description.en: Starting from a constant speed of light: time dilation in a light clock, spacetime diagrams and the Lorentz transformation, the relativity of simultaneity, muon lifetimes as evidence, relativistic velocity addition, and diverging kinetic energy showing why massive particles cannot reach c. Inertial observers, one dimension, c = 1.

label.en: At low speed it reduces to F = ma

reason.zh: 第 5 步显示相对论动能在 β 很小时与经典 ½mv² 几乎相同，牛顿力学是它的低速极限。
reason.en: Step 5 shows relativistic kinetic energy matches classical ½mv² at small β, so Newtonian mechanics is its low-speed limit.

label.zh: 光速在所有参考系相同
label.en: Light speed is the same in every frame

reason.zh: 第 4 步速度合成中 w = 1（光）对任何 v 结果都是 1，说明电磁波在所有观察者那里速度相同，与光谱页的波速概念一致。
reason.en: In step 4, w = 1 (light) gives u = 1 for any v, so electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed for every observer, consistent with the wave speed in the spectrum page.

title.zh: 为什么光速不能被超过？
title.en: Why can’t the speed of light be exceeded?

note: Physics advanced page; group follows atlas mechanics/wave nodes.
